description: The plot illustrates how a measured score (y-values) varies with the number of tokens for four sources: Tutorials, Library Documentation, a yellow series (label not visible due to a gray overlay in the legend), and Github files. The x-axis is labeled “Number of Tokens,” uses a linear scale, and spans from 200 to 1000 with labeled ticks at 200-unit intervals (200, 400, 600, 800; the 1000 point is plotted but not labeled). The y-axis is unlabeled, uses a linear scale, and ranges from 10 to 40 with labeled ticks every 10 units (10, 20, 30, 40). The Tutorials line is blue with circular markers and a solid stroke, increasing from about 23 at 200 tokens to about 27 at 500, reaching about 29 at 800, then slightly decreasing to about 28 at 1000. The Library Documentation line is red with circular markers and a solid stroke, rising from about 26 at 200 to about 29 at 500 and about 32 at 800, then dropping to about 27 at 1000. The Github files line is green with circular markers and a solid stroke, increasing from about 28 at 200 to about 30 at 500 and about 33 at 800, then decreasing to about 30 at 1000. The yellow line (legend label obscured) has circular markers and a solid stroke, starting near 33 at 200, slightly decreasing to about 30 at 500, then declining to about 19 at 800 and further to about 12 at 1000.
